Google Antigravity alternatives

Google Antigravity: Google's agent-first IDE: hand agents whole tasks and review what they did. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI coding tools from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1Claude CodeAn agent that works in your terminal and editor: reads the codebase, makes changes, runs the tests.Paid
  2. 2CursorA code editor built around AI, autocomplete that predicts edits, and agents that take tasks.Free plan
  3. 3GitHub CopilotCode suggestions, chat and a coding agent inside your editor and on GitHub.Free plan
  4. 4CodexOpenAI's coding agent, in the cloud, the terminal or your IDE, that ships pull requests.Paid
  5. 5WindsurfAn AI-native editor whose agent follows along with what you're doing.Free plan
  6. 6ReplitDescribe an app and its agent builds, hosts and deploys it in the browser.Free plan
  7. 7LovableFull-stack web apps from a conversation, with a real database behind them.Free plan
  8. 8BoltPrompt, run, edit and deploy full-stack apps without leaving the browser tab.Free plan
  9. 9v0Vercel's builder for polished React interfaces and apps from a prompt or a sketch.Free plan
  10. 10Gemini CLIGoogle's open-source coding agent for the terminal, with a generous free tier.Open source
  11. 11JulesGoogle's asynchronous coding agent: give it an issue, get back a pull request.Free plan
  12. 12ClineAn open-source coding agent for VS Code that asks before every step it takes.Open source
  13. 13AiderPair-programming in the terminal that commits each change to git as it goes.Open source
  14. 14ZedA very fast open-source editor with AI and agents built in.Open source

Free to start: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf.
